findings.message: handler module references ModelEventEnvelope -- Take the typed payload model; the envelope boundary is the shared runtime adapter, not the handler.
handler module holds module functions only (gather) -- Move the module functions into a handler class with handle(self, request: ModelX) -> ModelY.

HandlerRecording.record is a public method that mutates handler state (calls ['append']) -- Keep the handler stateless: return the new value from handle, or hold the state in an injected collaborator.

HandlerProbe.handle takes 3 positional parameters ['probes', 'pins', 'local_backends'] -- Give handle one typed request parameter, handle(self, request: ModelX) -> ModelY, and move the extra values into the request model.
